_comment: DELETION MANIFEST v1 — edited by humans only. Never auto-generated.

DELETE.description: Every record where created_by_id === user.id is permanently removed.

entities.name: OccupancyDay
entities.reason: Daily occupancy rows created during normal hotel operations. No shared state.

entities.name: SourceDay
entities.reason: Source-level daily revenue rows. Owned per user, no cross-user references.

entities.name: GrossRevenueDay
entities.reason: Gross revenue aggregates. Owned per user, no cross-user references.

entities.name: ClerkShiftRecord
entities.reason: Shift records created by the account being deleted. Not referenced by payroll rows after creation.

entities.name: UploadedReport
entities.reason: File references uploaded by this user. Drive files themselves are external; only the metadata row is deleted.

RETAIN.description: Records that must never be touched during an account wipe.

entities.name: AuditLog
entities.reason: Forensic evidence — append-only by design. audit_clear/entry.js enforces this as a hard 403.

entities.name: PayrollRun
entities.reason: Financial records with legal retention requirements. Deleting them would corrupt payroll history.

entities.name: Staff
entities.reason: Staff records are property-scoped, not user-scoped. Removing them would affect all admins of that property.

entities.name: Property
entities.reason: Property records are shared across all users with access. Cannot be deleted by a single user.

entities.name: Session
entities.reason: Sessions are invalidated by revoking (is_revoked=true), not by deletion. Deleting them would prevent logout detection.

entities.name: User
entities.reason: The User row itself is not deleted here — account deactivation (is_active=false) is a separate administrative action.

pagination.note: Use .filter({created_by_id: userId}, sort, PAGE, 0) — never .list(). Restart from offset 0 after each delete batch because rows shift forward. Exit when page.length === 0 or page.length < PAGE.

partialFailure.note: A single failed delete must not abort the rest of the wipe. Count failedDeletes and surface in response.recordsFailed and audit detail.

stallGuard.note: If 3 consecutive rounds make zero deletion progress while rows remain, the loop is stalled (delete calls repeatedly failing). Break with LOOP_STALLED to prevent 10k round trips.

auditPreflight.note: Check AUDIT_CHAIN_SECRET is configured BEFORE starting the destructive loop. If the secret is missing, the wipe still proceeds but a pre-wipe audit entry cannot be written — log a warning and continue. Do not block the wipe on audit failure.
